metadata_content.Passage: The Human Resources department at TechSolutions is reviewing its compensation structure for a specific engineering division. In this division, the average annual salary of a team manager is consistently 25% higher than the average annual salary of an entry-level engineer.
Statements: The combined annual salary for three entry-level engineers and two team managers in this division is $390,000.
The total annual salary of three entry-level engineers exceeds the total annual salary of two team managers by $15,000.
